title: Olive and Peruvian Inspired Tiradito
description: A refreshing Peruvian-inspired dish marinated in olive oil and mixed with quietly flavorful ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a hot summer day.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, aji amarillo peppers, cilantro, and lime juice.
Add the sliced onion to the bowl and mix well.
Add the Tiradito fish to the bowl and mix gently to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional aji amarillo peppers if desired.
